paragraphs.text: Li'l Giri is a warrior from a distant, unnamed plane. He appears to be a sapient, anthropomorphic onigiri , and is stated to have "an unknown filling".
Li'l Giri is described as "a brave li'l warrior from a distant li'l plane", with a strong sense of justice and sword skills.

The three Orb of Dragonkind promo arts depict him stealing a glowing orb, escaping with it, and being surprised by the appearance of a dragon. The flavor texts of his Secret Lair cards tell a story in which Giri rescues a child from being eaten by a robot. Aside from the dragon and robot, all of the other characters shown on Li'l Giri's cards are also anthropomorphic onigiri.
